en-US.longDescription:
Eclipse Temurin JRE is the open source Java SE build based upon OpenJRE.

This Winget package is designed for if a JRE-requiring app specifically requires an x86 runtime even on x64 Windows OS installations.
en-US.name: Eclipse Temurin JRE with Hotspot 19 (x86)
